name: audit-workflow
description: Evidence-first audit lifecycle with read-only deep review, feature-scattering analysis, shared fix proof, independent verification, hooks, and MCP tools.

interface.shortDescription: Evidence-led reviews and audit ticket lifecycle
interface.longDescription: Read-only deep review and feature-scattering analysis, plus discovery, triage, resolution, and independent verification through one local Python runtime. Local Claude Code and Codex integration; Codex hooks require explicit trust.
defaultPrompt: Use deep-review to inspect this change without creating audit state.
Use audit-discovery to record evidence-backed findings for this project.
Use audit-resolution to fix the next unblocked ticket and hand it to an independent verifier.
